paragraphs: Tampa Bay Rays won, the side Leo's model favored.
Griffin Jax (Tampa Bay Rays), the starter Leo's pitcher score favored, actually outpitched Dustin May: 4.0 IP, 2 ER (4.50 ERA) against 3.0 IP, 2 ER (6.00 ERA). The edge held up.

The Milwaukee Brewers bullpen was not flagged pregame, but it had a night worth noting: 1 earned run allowed over 8.0 relief innings (1.13 ERA) — quietly better than the pregame read implied. Note: 1 of the runs charged to the Milwaukee Brewers pitching staff overall was unearned — not something the bullpen's stuff should be blamed for.

The Tampa Bay Rays bullpen was flagged as elevated risk pregame (Tired). In relief it actually allowed 1 earned run over 8.0 innings (1.13 ERA) — the risk read did not show up on the scoreboard tonight.
Milwaukee Brewers scored 3 in a game that went 12 innings — not compared against the 4 pregame projection, which assumed nine.
